patterns: Money Bill is the hub: House of introduction (Lok Sabha only), Art.110 definition, 14-day RS limit, Speaker's certificate final, no joint sitting, President cannot return.
Joint sitting: Art.108 (trap: Art.109 in statements), summoned by President who 'notifies intention', Speaker presides, excluded for Money and Constitution Amendment Bills.
Parliament composition (President + LS + RS) and 'Bill becomes Act after President's assent' recur as one-liners.
Stages: general discussion = Second Reading; APPSC-G1 2024 used lapse-on-dissolution statement; pocket veto asked by APPSC.
App goes deeper (FB-I vs FB-II matrices, Speaker's certificate endorsements, private members' committee, 2025-26 current affairs) than the mostly direct single-fact PYQs.
